scripts.test: npm run test -w shared && npm run test -w api && npm run test -w app
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p shared --noEmit && tsc -p api --noEmit && tsc -p app --noEmit
scripts.deploy:app:teste: npm run build -w app -- --mode teste && npx --yes firebase-tools@13.29.1 deploy --only hosting:teste
scripts.deploy:app:producao: npm run build -w app -- --mode producao && npx --yes firebase-tools@13.29.1 deploy --only hosting:producao
